design.catalog: Four independent metadata filters combined with search; existing catalog authority retained.
design.detail: Reload on identity/dependency replacement; reject mismatched/empty pinned content; expose actual word count and revision.
design.progress: Introduce exact pack revision projection using durable session configuration and canonical validated first attempts. Unattributed legacy sessions must not become pack progress.
design.launch: Verify existing configuration launch pins against selected detail identity; preserve existing runtime authority.

discoveryFailures.reason: Guessed session screen paths absent; Windows glob passed as path
discoveryFailures.resolution: Stop guessed-path searches; use rg --files -g discovery then literal paths
